title: Choir and Wolf
author: Dominic Thackeray
blurb: Vesper Amberdale, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
